description: This file defines a PHP class 'AlertsViewDefault' which extends 'SugarView'. The class contains methods for displaying alert views in the SuiteCRM platform, including setting page titles and rendering a Smarty template for the alerts module.

classes.name: AlertsViewDefault
classes.description: A view class responsible for handling the display of alerts within the SuiteCRM Alerts module.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters; in this case, it returns 'Alerts' for the page title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Assigns variables to the Smarty template engine and renders the default alert template before terminating execution.
